style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots, soft mint #DCE8DE and sage #BFD0C0 panels for info shots, deep pine green #4F7D62 for feature annotation, warm ivory #F5F3EE for lifestyle and spec screens
style.iconSystem: thin-line single-color icons in deep pine green #4F7D62, rounded square and circular card containers
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, cool neutral white balance, no harsh speculars on the glossy shell
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh clean personal-care appliance visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of ivory white #F5F3EE, soft mint green #DCE8DE, deep pine green #4F7D62 and charcoal text #33383D; bright soft studio lighting with front-left key, soft contact shadows and cool neutral white balance; modern geometric sans-serif with bold short headlines and a small pill badge; consistent thin-line single-color icon style in rounded cards; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no invented efficacy claims or numbers
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the egg-shaped handheld body across the set, device always upright with light window visible
style.surfaceSystem: matte ribbed podium, smooth ivory stone counter and clean matte infographic boards
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, bold short headlines with a small pill badge above
